insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options vary by plan (e.g., 5/10/15/20/25/50/100/200 Lakhs depending on plan as per Annexure C). Exact Sum Insured is as per Policy Schedule.

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Room rent limit shall be At Actuals unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule.
great.explanation: Room rent is payable at actuals unless a different limit is shown in the Policy Schedule. This reduces the risk of room-category restrictions cutting down your claim payout.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: The Secure Benefit will be applicable only after exhaustion of Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: Secure Benefit becomes available only after the Base Sum Insured is fully exhausted. This provides extra insurer-funded cover in high-cost or multiple-claim years.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: The restored Sum Insured can be used even for the same illness for which an admissible claim has been paid during the Policy Year and also for any other Illness covered under the Policy.
great.explanation: Restored Sum Insured can be used even for the same illness in the same Policy Year, and also for other covered illnesses. This helps if the same condition needs repeat hospitalization within the year.

great.name: No Claim Bonus
great.quote: This Cover will be applied irrespective of number of claims made under the expiring Policy.
great.explanation: The renewal bonus applies irrespective of the number of claims in the expiring policy. This means the benefit is not lost just because you made a claim.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months (Unless specified otherwise in the Policy Schedule) of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage unless the Policy Schedule specifies otherwise. This is a common waiting period, so early-year PED claims will not be payable.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Listed conditions/surgeries are covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage. This can delay payouts for certain planned treatments in the first two years.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered for the first 30 days from the policy start date, except accidents. This is standard, so non-accident claims in the first month are typically rejected.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 60 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately prior to the date of admission.
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered unless the Policy Schedule states otherwise. This helps pay for tests, consultations, and medicines leading up to admission.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 180 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately post the date of discharge from the Hospital.
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 180 days after discharge are covered unless the Policy Schedule states otherwise. This supports follow-up treatment and medicines during recovery.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify expenses incurred by the Insured Person during the Policy Year towards Ambulance transportation in an airplane or helicopter for Emergency Care... subject to a maximum of Sum Insured as specified in the Policy Schedule against this Cover
good.explanation: Air ambulance (airplane/helicopter) for emergency care is covered up to the limit shown in the Policy Schedule. This can be valuable for critical transfers, but payouts are capped.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Any Kit with no details mentioned [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHO KIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC.] ... GLOVES ... MASK ... VASOFIX SAFETY
bad.reference: Annexure B - Items for which Coverage is not available in the Policy (Non-Medical Expenses), Pages 49-50
bad.explanation: Many non-medical/consumable items (such as kits, gloves, masks, etc.) are listed as not covered. This can materially increase out-of-pocket costs during hospitalization.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-Payment means a cost sharing requirement under a health insurance policy that provides that the policyholder/insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claims amount.
bad.explanation: A co-payment clause exists in the document, meaning you may have to bear a specified percentage of the admissible claim amount. This directly reduces the insurer payout and increases your share of every claim where co-pay applies.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
